titulo: Police investigating Ann Widdecombe murder reopen attempted burglary case from 2025
cuerpo: Watchdog examines alleged failure to pursue a line of inquiry ‘which may have been relevant’ Counter-terrorism police investigating the death of Ann Widdecombe say they have reopened an old investigation into an attempted burglary last year. The incident at an address in Greater London was reported in April 2025. Continue reading...
